rubric_items.reason: Checked the six changed files at head and found no missed weakness. The query is parameterised, with_today is validated, the link is encoded and rendered as text, and the one real authorisation gap (SF-1) is reported.

The 'checked with no finding' cites hit the exact lines (appointmentRepo L126-131, doctorService L35, DoctorsPage L86). SF-1 cites the service call at L57, not the route line that declares doctors:read.
SF-1 is minor. That fits, because the MVP grants every permission (architecture#identity), so nothing is exposed today. The question about future roles is correctly non-blocking.
SF-1 gives a concrete fix: check appointments:read before computing today_count. Q-01 gives options and a default.
No false positives. SF-1 is real: GET / declares only doctors:read and returns appointment counts.

findings.text: SF-1 is about which permission the route declares, but it cites only the service line that runs the count. The guard itself is declared at api/src/routes/doctors.ts L14, and that line is not cited.
